title: Electric Service by Rate Schedule Terms of Payment: Late Charge Rates for Repeat Late Payment
content:
**Late charge rate by payment history.** The late payment charge on an Electric Service by Rate Schedule bill is figured at a rate chosen from the payment history of the same service account, counted over the twelve whole months before the current date:

| Late payment charges dated less than twelve whole months before the current date | Returned payments dated in those twelve months | Late charge rate |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | One or more | 2.00 percent |
| Two or more | None | 1.75 percent |
| None or one | Any number | The schedule's late payment charge percentage — 1.50 percent on all seven schedules |

At the rate so chosen, the late payment charge is the late-charged amount of the bill multiplied by that rate as a percent, the product rounded once to the cent, and never less than the schedule's late charge minimum.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Prior late payment charges in the twelve months | Returned payments in the twelve months | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 1.50 percent — a single late payment charge does not reach "two or more" |
| 2 | 0 | 1.75 percent |
| 2 | 1 | 2.00 percent |
| 4 | 3 | 2.00 percent |
| 0 | 2 | 1.50 percent |

### Hypothetical figures

On a late-charged amount of $334.88, the 1.75 percent rate gives $5.8604, rounded to $5.86; the 2.00 percent rate gives $6.6976, rounded to $6.70.

### Points of reading

- The counts are of records on the same service account: the late payment charge lines and the returned payments dated less than twelve whole months before the current date.
- The returned payments counted are any returned payments in those twelve months, whatever the payment channel.
